::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm}
::: {.card-body}
<h3 class="card-title">NICE TA975 (CAR-T) Case Study</h3>
<h6 class="card-subtitle text-muted mb-2">Full Submission Replication</h6>
<p class="card-text">A complete end-to-end reconstruction of a CAR-T therapy appraisal (Tisagenlecleucel). Features state-transition modeling, parametric survival fitting, and ICER calculations via Patient Access Schemes (PAS).</p>
<a href="./TA975_Mock_Case.qmd" class="stretched-link">View Case Study &rarr;</a>

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm}
::: {.card-body}
<h3 class="card-title">Oncology PartSM Audit</h3>
<h6 class="card-subtitle text-muted mb-2">Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma</h6>
<p class="card-text">Forensic audit and technical remediation of a 3-state partitioned survival model. Showcases complex hazard-based treatment waning logic and full Probabilistic Sensitivity Analysis (PSA) validation.</p>
<a href="./01_Oncology_PartSM_Audit/Technical_Audit_Memo_RRMM.md" class="stretched-link">View Audit Memo &rarr;</a>
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm}
::: {.card-body}
<h3 class="card-title">ML-NMR Reconstruction</h3>
<h6 class="card-subtitle text-muted mb-2">Population Alignment & Synthesis</h6>
<p class="card-text">A deep dive into Multilevel Network Meta-Regression. Solves the "Extrapolation Gap" using 64-point Sobol integration and Cholesky decomposition to bridge IPD and AgD seamlessly in a Bayesian framework.</p>
<a href="./03_Bayesian_NMA_Reconstruction/MLNMR_Audit_Report.qmd" class="stretched-link">View ML-NMR Report &rarr;</a>
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm}
::: {.card-body}
<h3 class="card-title">RWE Causal Inference</h3>
<h6 class="card-subtitle text-muted mb-2">Observational Data Pipeline</h6>
<p class="card-text">An advanced R-based pipeline for real-world evidence processing. Implements IPTW, AIPW, and TMLE with SuperLearner ensembles to eliminate unobserved clinical confounding.</p>
<a href="./02_RWE_Causal_Inference_Pipeline/RWE_Forensic_Checklist.md" class="stretched-link">View Pipeline &rarr;</a>
